name: annotate
description: Annotate doer (capability plane): the tool subagent that builds and validates a dataset's machine-readable metadata — participants.json data dictionaries, BIDS sidecars, and controlled-term coverage against Neurobagel/SNOMED, ReproSchema and NIDM. It never recalls a term identifier — a term no tool returned is reported 'unannotated', and an uninstalled backend is reported unavailable rather than as zero matches. It writes but never commits; curate/annotate saves them with datalad save.
